subject: english
stem: Which ending result or final point follows “Weather may fall on a whole city, but people do not face it with the same protection.”?
options: Sometimes opening a door is enough to invite people in.
Public planning matters most when private comfort is not enough.
In public planning, it is also a decision about the future city.
Human comfort matters, but so do the needs of small lives that disappear when nights become too bright.

optionRationales.reason: 本文沒有陳述「Sometimes opening a door is enough to invite people in.」；這個選項混入另一個情境的資訊。
本文可直接核對「Weather may fall on a whole city, but people do not face it with the same protection. Public planning matters most when…」，所以這個選項符合完整語境。
本文沒有陳述「In public planning, it is also a decision about the future city.」；這個選項混入另一個情境的資訊。

independentReviews.evidence: 獨立覆核 A：在鎖定文章中定位「Weather may fall on a whole city, but people do not face it with the same protection. Public planning matters most when private comfort…」，答案為「Public planning matters most when private comfort is not enough.」。
獨立覆核 B：逐項回查文章，只有「Public planning matters most when private comfort is not enough.」有同篇證據，三個干擾項均來自不同情境。
